method: Only current competent first-party Church sources control publication. The current official metropolis roster names 46 principal churches, four monasteries or hesychasteria, and 39 chapels or other worship bodies. All exact rendered names are published. Search and map results remain leads only.

candidates.name: Aggregate and named roster reconciliation for the Holy Metropolis of Thessaloniki
candidates.status: named current roster published; aggregate discrepancy held
candidates.reason: The Ecumenical Patriarchate aggregate reports 94 churches and chapels: 42 parish churches, four pilgrimage churches, and 48 subordinate worship bodies, including ten monastic churches or chapels. The current metropolis pages render 46 principal churches, four monastic bodies, and 39 named subordinate worship bodies. The rendered names are published without manufacturing the unnamed difference or altering the current source categories.

candidates.name: Monastic churches and chapels not individually named by the current roster
candidates.status: hold for exact identities from a competent current roster
candidates.reason: The Ecumenical Patriarchate aggregate reports ten monastic churches or chapels, but the current metropolis chapel page does not enumerate that category. Narrative references inside profiles are not promoted into separate bodies without a current exact roster identity.

candidates.name: Search and map discoveries not tied to the current official roster
candidates.reason: Search engines and maps can identify possible worship bodies, but no body is published until the competent current Church source confirms its exact identity and canonical parentage.

source_reconciliations.decision: Publish all 46 principal churches, four monastic bodies, and 39 subordinate worship bodies named by the current official metropolis pages. Preserve the source category and source spelling for every body.

Hold the unnamed difference between the Ecumenical Patriarchate aggregate and the current rendered metropolis roster. Do not infer missing identities or recategorize named bodies to make the totals agree.

Publish only institutional contact data shown by a current official Church source. Seventeen body domains were retained after a current HTTPS response check. A domain with an invalid TLS hostname, a conflicting site described as under reconstruction, and social profile links were not treated as body-owned sites. No personal clergy contact was added.
